notes.text: Vincent Tang said the vega VaR will be implemented soon and asked Jonathan Le whether all vega positions are captured in the database.
Jonathan Le reported (11/30/99) that vega is now captured every day, but the limit validation on vega is down.
Jonathan Le suggested coordinating with Debbie (Brackett) and Rudi (Zipter) to address the vega limit validation problem.
